label: Cover
notes: One line: Mason is the practical builder of the pyforge factory — once Atlas has mapped the landscape and Warden has cleared the perimeter, Mason binds raw software ingredients into concrete, production-ready structures. Behind the persona stands a working forge: 769 feedstocks.

label: Act I — The Artisan
notes: Act I: who Mason is. The practical builder — after the map and the perimeter comes the binding: raw ingredients into unyielding structures.

label: Dual-ecosystem mastery
notes: Mindset one: PyPI and Conda are complementary building blocks, not rivals. PyPI for fast pure-Python agility; Conda for heavy analytics, compiled C-extensions, and hardware-accelerated platforms.

label: Structural integrity
notes: Mindset two: Mason rejects brittle runtime environments. Everything is deterministic, binary-compatible, and reproducible — developer needs converted into unyielding cross-platform structures.

label: Act II — The craft
notes: Act II: the craft itself — recipes, releases, and environment binding.

label: The three crafts
notes: The three crafts and their CLI: recipe crafting (v1 recipe.yaml — selectors, multi-outputs, skips), library distribution (simultaneous wheel + conda release), environment binding (unified lockfiles across pip and conda).

label: Act III — The forge today
notes: Act III: unlike most visions, Mason's forge is already running at scale — the AI-assisted conda-forge packaging factory behind this repo.

label: A working forge
notes: Mason's real grounding: the AI-assisted packaging factory — 769 maintained feedstocks, the full staged-recipes lifecycle from generation to PR submission, and the modern rattler-build + pixi toolchain.

label: Ship to both worlds
notes: The payoff: one release, two registries — the same library lands as wheel and conda package from one synchronized pipeline; one lockfile serves every platform. Downstream usability maximized.

label: We ship the structure
notes: Close on the motto: we forge the blocks, we bind the environment, we ship the structure. Hand the pristine artifacts to Herald for the proclamation.
